class.name: FlatButton
class.description: [FlatButton] does not display anything. Using input action events to process input.

method.name: _pressed
method.description: Called when the button is pressed.

method.name: is_hovered
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the mouse has entered the button and has not left it yet.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the button is in disabled state and can't be clicked or toggled.
Determines when the button is considered clicked, one of the [enum PressMode] constants.
Input action event names, associated to the button.
Shortcut input action event names, associated to the button.

signal.name: down
signal.description: Emitted when the button starts being held down.

signal.name: up
signal.description: Emitted when the button stops being held down.

signal.name: pressed
signal.description: Emitted when the button is pressed. This is on [signal down] if [member press_mode] is [constant PRESS_MODE_PRESS] and on [signal up] otherwise.

constants.constant: Require just a press to consider the button clicked.
Require a press and a subsequent release before considering the button clicked.
